output.summary: Agency spend growth is mostly volume (about 77%), not price. A self-reinforcing loop is supported. Higher agency share raises charge and orientation load on permanent RNs, and that load precedes resignations by about two quarters. The 4 West pilot cut load, exhaustion and resignations against matched units. Resignations were rising before St. Brennan's opened, and only 19 of 98 known leavers went there. Workload is the main exit reason, and pay is secondary. The 2025 bonus did not stop vacancies rising. The CFO plan to suspend the charge and preceptor differentials would worsen the load. Extend the 4 West model. Renegotiating the escalator is a modest supplementary lever, since price explains only about 23% of the increase.
